thread:
sarah: Hey team — customer on Private is hitting TOOL_NOT_FOUND on a function call after we pushed a synonym/alias update yesterday. Request and response attached.
sarah: Repro (customer env):

```
POST /v1/call
{
  "tool": "pdf-extract",
  "args": { "url": "https://cust.example.com/file.pdf" }
}
```
sarah: Response: 404 {"error":"tool not found","code":"TOOL_NOT_FOUND"}

sarah: This started ~2025-11-03 22:05 local. Other tools work. The registry shows the tool as `PDF-Extract` (upper P/D) on our catalog. Could this be a casefolding/alias propagation problem? @oncall-ml @matt :eyes:

matt: Can you paste the raw registry lookup from the customer control plane? Curious whether the alias table has the old and new keys concurrently.
matt: Quick check you can run from their machine:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" "https://private-registry.cust/v1/tools?name=pdf-extract"
```

sarah: Ran that — registry returned two entries: one with name "PDF-Extract" (uuid a1b2) and one with alias "pdf-extract" (uuid a1b2) but alias TTL is 0 and last_synced 2025-11-03T21:58:12Z

liam: That TTL=0 smells like a backfill/propagation job skipped for this private deploy. We had a recent change where rename operations generated a temporary uppercase canonical name and then wrote an alias. If alias write failed, caller-facing lookup will miss the lower-case key.

deploy-bot: Job synonymy-backfill/2025-11-03 finished with status WARNING. 7/220 hosts failed to apply alias update.

matt: On private installs the host-level sync agent reports transient errors when the registry lock is held. Could be the sync agent didn't pick the write. If the customer is hitting a specific edge host that didn't get alias, calls route to host without alias -> 404.

raj: Quick mitigation: create a fallback mapping entry for that customer's control plane
```
PATCH /v1/registry/aliases
{ "tool_uuid": "a1b2", "alias": "pdf-extract", "ttl": 2592000 }
```
raj: That will let calls resolve while we run full backfill. Also I recommend we run the per-tenant retry: `scripts/alias-backfill --tenant cust_id --force`.

sarah: Running patch now, will update. Customer is blocked for document ingestion so this is high priority.

support-bot: Noted — customer ticket #45321 flagged P1, billing impact: ingestion pipeline retries are generating extra token usage.

sarah: Patch applied, initial tests show 200s for calls that previously 404ed. Need a permanent fix for sync job.

liam: I'll triage the sync agent logs across the private fleet. Likely causes: lock contention + casefolding mismatch in the store (some stores treat keys case-sensitively). We'll add a guard to normalize on write and an idempotent alias apply step.

matt: Can someone add a short repro note to the incident thread and attach the host id that returned the 404? We should capture which host still had old index.

sarah: Host id: host-dc3-87. I saved the debug trace to the ticket. Thanks all, will keep monitoring.

oncall-ml: FYI if any downstream evals used that tool key during the window they may have silently routed to the fallback model. I'll check the rollout logs for any regressions.

raj: After backfill we'll run `scripts/alias-audit --tenant cust_id` and publish results. Planning to push retry fix tomorrow.

sarah: Closing loop: customer confirmed ingestion resumed. Filing a follow-up to harden alias write on private deployments. :thumbsup:
